Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/account/service/AccountLifecycleService.java only.
- Autowire UserRepository, GdprExportRequestRepository, UserProfileRepository.
- Methods:
  * requestAccountDeletion(Long userId, String confirmationPassword): verifies password, sets user.deletedAt = Instant.now() (soft delete), revokes tokens, returns deletionScheduledAt.
  * cancelAccountDeletion(Long userId): resets user.deletedAt = null.
  * requestGdprExport(Long userId): creates GdprExportRequest with status 'PENDING', returns request object.
  * getExportStatus(Long userId): returns latest GdprExportRequest.
  * purgeExpiredAccounts(): scheduled or callable job that permanently hard-deletes users whose deletedAt is older than 30 days.
